title: WTO Internship Programme
description: A paid internship at the World Trade Organization Secretariat in Geneva, open to postgraduate students and recent postgraduates from any WTO member, observer government, or country/customs territory in WTO accession negotiations. Interns work alongside WTO staff on trade law, economics, statistics, IT, languages, communications, or administration, for up to six months. WTO covers economy-class return airfare to and from Geneva and pays a daily allowance (CHF 60/day for most nationals, CHF 90/day for nationals of Least Developed Countries -- roughly CHF 1,800-2,700 per month), plus a CHF 100/month contribution toward health insurance. According to the WTO's own careers page, intake to the programme runs on an ongoing basis with no single fixed recruitment period -- individual internship vacancies are posted year-round on the WTO's e-recruitment site as positions open, with a currently posted vacancy showing an application deadline of 31 December 2026 as one example of the rolling cycle.
visaNote: This is an internship placement at an international organization in Switzerland, not general employment; the WTO facilitates the necessary permit arrangements for interns.
